'''Walter Borho''' (born 1945) is a German [[mathematician]], who works on [[algebra]] and [[number theory]]. He is retired as a university professor at the [[University of Wuppertal]].<ref>{{cite book|url=https://www.uni-wuppertal.de/fileadmin/data/bu/01/pdf/VeroeffentlichungenBroschueren/Rektoratsbericht/web-final15.pdf|title=Rektoratsbericht|contribution=Emeritiert, Pensioniert, Ausgeschieden|page=46|publisher=University of Wuppertal|year=2010|access-date=12 March 2025}}</ref>

==Early life and education==
Borho was born in 1945 in [[Hamburg]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://d-nb.info/gnd/1013288300|title=Borho, Walter|work=Katalog der Deutschen Nationalbibliothek|access-date=12 March 2025}}</ref> He received his PhD in 1973 from the [[University of Hamburg]] under the direction of [[Ernst Witt]] with a thesis titled ''Wesentliche ganze Erweiterungen kommutativer Ringe''.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=21228}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
In 1986 he was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in [[Berkeley, California]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mathunion.org/icm-plenary-and-invited-speakers?combine=borho|title=ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers|publisher=International Mathematical Union|access-date=12 March 2025}}</ref>
